chunks: From him, from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥusayn, from some of his companions, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
He said to his companions: “Indeed, tomorrow you will come to a place in which there is no water, so perform ghusl today for tomorrow.” So we performed ghusl on Thursday for Friday.

key_terms.الْجُمُعَةِ: Friday, the intended day for which the ghusl was prepared
key_terms.الْخَمِيسِ: Thursday, the day on which the ghusl was performed
key_terms.مَنْزِلًا: a stopping place or location where they would arrive

ai.seo_question: Can ghusl for Friday be performed a day earlier if water will not be available later?
ai.summary: This hadith indicates the permissibility of performing ghusl in advance when access to water will not be available at the needed time. It reflects a practical ruling connected to acts of worship and ritual purity, specifically regarding preparing for Friday in advance.
